prose: Never use console.log; use the project logger.
Do not import from the deprecated design system (@acme/legacy-ui).
All exported functions must be prefixed with 'mk'.
Never hardcode secrets (passwords, API keys, tokens) in source.
note: checker synthesized NAIVELY on purpose -> should fail its own self-test and abstain

prose: Empty catch blocks are forbidden: never silently swallow a caught error.
Do not use the `any` type; use a specific type or `unknown`.
Never use eslint-disable to suppress linting errors.
Never use a bare `except:`; always catch a specific exception type.
note: Python (ast-grep). AST rule `except:` stays clean on typed/tuple forms + string/comment embeddings a regex leaks on.

prose: Never use print(); use the project logger.
note: Python (ast-grep). NAIVE `print($A)` on purpose — passes self-test (single-arg) but under-flags zero/multi-arg on gold -> abstain-gold (recall leak). Sound form is `print($$$A)`.
Python (ast-grep). `eval($$$A)` — variadic (the fix for P2's arity bug); AST-anchored so `model.eval()` (attribute) and `ast.literal_eval` don't match.
